name: Dulwich College (Singapore)
summary: British independent school model in Bukit Batok with IGCSEs and IB Diploma — verify Mandarin as immersion vs optional language by year group.
body: Dulwich Singapore brings a UK independent-school culture to the west, with strong performing arts and academic pathways through IGCSE into IB Diploma — note the senior exit is typically IB DP rather than Singapore-Cambridge A-Level, so do not shortlist it as a pure A-Level substitute without reading the current pathway page. Forum school-choice threads often name Dulwich when families want British structure plus some Mandarin exposure — but optional language slots are not bilingual immersion. Ask admissions for weekly Mandarin hours by year and whether intensity continues past junior school. Bukit Batok geography pairs with west-side housing; peak CBD reverse-commute is a separate adult problem from the child bus. Tour early and price the full fee stack including bus. CCA selection culture and school-run holiday camps shape family calendars as much as classroom pathways — ask for current CCA handbooks and camp timelines early. Confirm CCA vs after-school academy stacking guidance for dual-career families, plus sideline/fixture communication norms. Dual-career note: overnight trip medication packets and allergy forms belong in the portal early — not the morning of the coach.
waitlistNotes: Year-group dependent; early registration recommended. Confirm Mandarin pathway intensity by year in writing.
